name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H2", "why": "Previous favourite H2 (protein_interaction, favoured after T1, decision round 1) keeps the lead, at low confidence. Test T2 weakened its location premise: R226 lies in no predicted protein-protein interface (in_predicted_interface null) and sits in a buried pocket (buriedness 0.77, pLDDT 97.3), so the interface assumption is not supported by this model. Rival H1 (stability_folding) is also weakened: its direct test T1 returned FoldX +0.51 kcal/mol (below the 2.0 threshold, pLDDT 96.69), with only E7 (MD on a homology model) supporting it. T2 did not address H1's stability premise, so H1 gains nothing and stays weakened. H1 has no measured stability support beyond E7, so H2 still has more direct support, though both are weakened and the margin is small. Test IDs: T1, T2. Evidence IDs: E9, E11, E17, E18, E20, E7, E21, E22, E23."}
